title: Insert + query across relationships
summary: Create lab_teams / lab_players with FK relationship.
description:
Create lab_teams / lab_players with FK relationship.

Why: Inserts must respect FKs; queries must JOIN/include to reassemble the graph — schema alone is not enough for production thinking.
hints: Read gate errors as cause→effect: each message names what Postgres still lacks.

sql: SELECT p.name, t.name FROM lab_players p JOIN lab_teams t ON t.id = p.team_id
probes.message: The gate inserts 2 teams + 3 players into your schema (rolled back afterwards) and joins them — the JOIN must return all 3 players.

why: Inserts must respect FKs; queries must JOIN/include to reassemble the graph — schema alone is not enough for production thinking.
pitfalls: Forgetting to expose the FK column the JOIN needs.
teachAlong: Effect: INSERT order + JOIN/include to read.
mappingNotes: Compare your ORM/schema code with the Equivalent SQL panel. The task gate introspects Postgres — only real tables/FKs count.
